purpose: Service review for WUP2025 rank 541 San Miguel de Tucumán (city code 1458); city-local registry basis and safe anonymous parcel-geometry access status.
primaryPublisher: Municipality of San Miguel de Tucumán and Tucumán DGC
registryBasis: The municipality’s Catastro y Edificación office states that it maintains the municipal property and real-estate register and handles parcel identification, valuation and boundary-related procedures. The municipal guide says property-specific consultations require identity and proof of interest, so no such query was made. The provincial DGC public map advertises parcel layers and has a public WFS metadata/schema route; this confirms local cadastre evidence, but its bounded geometry requests timed out and no sample was obtained.

officialSources.observation: Municipal Catastro says it manages and maintains the municipal property/real-estate register and handles identification, valuation, delimitation and updating of cadastral information.

Municipal Catastro y Edificación guide describes that specific property information requires DNI and evidence of interest; this route was not submitted. It also identifies Catastro and Edificación/land-survey services.

Official DGC map HTML exposes a padrón search field and parcel/map controls; no padrón value was entered. Static JavaScript declares WMS layers PARCELASR and PARCELASRUBE at the official mapas.catastrotucuman.gov.ar GeoServer.
Official WMS GetCapabilities returned public map layers including PARCELASR, PARCELASRUBE, streets and block layers; no feature rows were requested.
Official WFS GetCapabilities lists feature types including dgct:PARCELASRUBE and dgct:parcelas.
Schema only: GEOMETRY (Surface), KEY (string), ADMPCOLOR (decimal), DESCRIP (string); no owner/name/address/tax fields.

accessReview.reason: The official DGC map and WFS metadata are public, and the selected parcel layer schema is geometry plus non-personal fields. Two bounded GetFeature requests restricted to GEOMETRY and capped at three features timed out without an HTTP response. The WUP-point polygon is therefore unverified; do not infer absence of parcels or citywide coverage.

rootRegistryAssessment: San Miguel de Tucumán’s own SMT municipal guide explicitly locates the Directorate of Catastro and Edificación in this city and documents parcel division, unification and registration procedures. The provincial Tucumán DGC public map and WFS metadata corroborate local cadastral mapping. No full parcel polygon was obtained from three bounded geometry-only requests; this is not an absence claim.
